# Historical numerical excerpts

These are the originally supplied small transcriptions used by Cells 21 and 22, not newly downloaded full experimental datasets. Cell 21 embeds 258 KamLAND prompt energies, the nonzero fission-flux bins, background subsamples and release inputs. Cell 22 embeds only the Daya Bay amplitude rows and local checks used by its interpolation, not all 10,000 entries of the collaboration grid. See the unchanged cell code and `docs/notes/DCU_Mass_Cell_21_NOTES.md` and `_22_NOTES.md` for exact provenance, resolution and limitations.

They are supplied to reproduce this historical calculation, not to supersede the collaboration releases. No new likelihood, covariance or precision is inferred.
